chandlerActivities.title: Chandler Ostrich Festival
chandlerActivities.description: A signature Chandler event featuring ostrich races, concerts, carnival rides, and local food.

chandlerActivities.title: Veterans Oasis Park & Solar System Walk
chandlerActivities.description: A desert preserve with a scale-model solar system walk, wildlife viewing, and scenic trails.

chandlerActivities.title: Arizona Railway Museum
chandlerActivities.description: Explore historic locomotives, cabooses, and passenger cars in an interactive rail museum.

chandlerActivities.title: Historic Downtown Chandler
chandlerActivities.description: Art deco architecture, murals, boutique shops, restaurants, and frequent community events.

chandlerActivities.title: Chandler Center for the Arts
chandlerActivities.description: A unique rotating-stage theater offering concerts, plays, comedy, and cultural performances.

chandlerActivities.title: Chandler Museum & McCullough-Price House
chandlerActivities.description: A modern museum with rotating exhibits and a historic 1938 mansion next door.

chandlerActivities.title: Tumbleweed Park & Playtopia
chandlerActivities.description: A massive themed playground and park that hosts Chandler’s major seasonal events.

chandlerActivities.title: Chandler Fashion Center & Outdoor Village
chandlerActivities.description: A popular shopping and entertainment district with fountains, art, and seasonal events.
